af9e46b182.q: What was the business impact of Spot freight building its own TMS technology platform from scratch?
af9e46b182.a: Building in-house tech was the fundamental decision that led to growth. What started as a $500,000 investment estimated to take 12 months ended up taking several years and over a million dollars. The TMS now processes 9,000 to 10,000 loads a month with full SaaS functionality including routing, visibility, reporting, and invoicing. Without building their own tech, it would be impossible to handle the volume and unique requirements they face today.

16ac9c9602.q: How did API pricing automation change Spot freight's rate management capabilities since 2024?
16ac9c9602.a: API pricing represents one of the craziest recent developments. In the first year of API pricing, Spot sent out 1.6 million rates on individual shipments. Before, every single quote was manual through email or customer portals. Now with API, a quote can come, be accepted automatically, and flow all the way through to carrier matching and shipment without manual intervention, compared to 33 months ago when the entire process required manual entry.
